title: OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework
summary: Explore OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework and how our AI safety, security, and risk practices align with emerging EU and California regulations.
body: Explore OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework and how our AI safety, security, and risk practices align with emerging EU and California regulations.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布前沿治理框架，阐述了其AI安全、安全保障与风险管理实践如何与欧盟和加州法规保持一致。原始信息显示：Explore OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework and how our AI safety, security, and risk practices align with emerging EU and California regulations.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework”。其重要性主要体现在：介绍了OpenAI的前沿治理框架及其如何适应欧盟和加州的新兴法规。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
